title: Beyond the Mountain
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Thane Hallvard wants his two elders' counsel on what could be driving the kobolds into Silverdelve.

Level22
LengthShort

Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring in the steps recorded so far.

Steps

  1. Talk to Thane Hallvard to get the quest.
  2. Talk to Elder Brunna inside Frostspire
  3. Talk to Elder Thrain inside Frostspire

Rewards

Reward
Gold896
Character XP28,000
Quest points1

What Thane Hallvard says

You: The thane wants to know what you've seen.

Elder Brunna: Fires. When I was young the frost giants kept to the far north. This winter I can see their camps from the ridge, out on the Rime.

Elder Brunna: They're a little closer every night. Go and hear Thrain. He'll tell you it's trolls, and he's right too.

You: Brunna says the frost giants are coming south across the Rime.

Elder Thrain: They are. And the ice trolls are running ahead of them. They've come down into the Westreach, where our woodcutters used to go.

Elder Thrain: Kobolds are afraid of trolls, and trolls are afraid of giants. That's what has your kobolds digging into our mine.

Elder Thrain: We can't fight giants yet, but we can fight trolls. I have a job for you if you want it.

Handing it in
